newsitem.title: USA: IMF says Kenya loan will lapse from today.
newsitem.headline: IMF says Kenya loan will lapse from today.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund has rejected a Kenyan request to extend a three-year Enhanced Structural Adjustment Facility loan, a spokesman said on Thursday.
The spokesman said measures proposed by the government did not meet IMF concerns. "The ESAF arrangement will lapse today," he added.

"The management of the International Monetary Fund has examined Kenya's request for an extension of the current ESAF arrangement and considers that the measures that the government is prepared to take fall short of meeting the clearly expressed concerns of IMF member countries in the area of governance," the spokesman said.

The IMF, in the last of a series of extensions, last week gave the Kenyan authorities until the end of this month to increase transparency in the public sector and crack down on corruption. It said then that the loan would lapse if the government did not do enough.
Kenyan Finance Minister Musalia Mudavadi said on Thursday that the government had asked the IMF to extend the deadline.
